paper_title: Searches for electron interactions induced by new physics in the EDELWEISS-III germanium bolometers
notes: Paper reports multiple limits: solar axion CBRD g_ae < 1.1e-11 (massless limit), g_ae x g_aN^eff < 3.5e-17 at 14.4 keV, electron decay lifetime, and ALP/hidden-photon DM absorption over 0.8-500 keV (Fig.5). The DM absorption g_ae vs mass curve and hidden-photon kappa curve are only in figures with no numerical tables/text values extractable. Only the solar-axion massless-limit value g_ae<1.1e-11 is given explicitly in text (here placed at m=0). DM density 0.3 GeV/cm^3 applies to the absorption searches; the quoted point is solar (not DM-density-dependent).
